# POST /api/auth/signout

Sign out of the current session.

Revokes the organization/user-scoped session selected by a verified user access token.
Cookie requests require a trusted Origin and clear both HttpOnly authentication cookies.
Bearer requests revoke the selected session without changing browser cookies.
Repeating signout for an already revoked session succeeds while the access token is valid.
Other sessions remain active. Already-issued access JWTs remain valid until expiry.

## Authentication

Satisfy one of these alternatives (schemes within one alternative are all required):

- `{"bearerAuth":[]}`



```json
{
  "scheme": "bearer",
  "type": "http"
}
```
- `{"accessCookie":[]}`

HttpOnly access cookie; nonsecure local development uses compallm-access. Automatic renewal additionally requires the configured refresh cookie.

```json
{
  "description": "HttpOnly access cookie; nonsecure local development uses compallm-access. Automatic renewal additionally requires the configured refresh cookie.",
  "in": "cookie",
  "name": "__Host-access",
  "type": "apiKey"
}
```

## Example request

```bash
curl --request POST 'https://compallm.example/api/auth/signout' --header 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```

Replace URL parameters and supply any required query values and authentication described above.
